user.title: Set up BYD Battery Box
user.description: Please provide connection details to BYD Battery Box. Only one Modbus connection is accepted by the battery: close other tools (e.g. BE Connect) before.

data.name: Name
data.scan_interval: Scan Interval in Seconds for the BMU
data.bms_scan_interval: Scan Interval in Seconds for BMS Unit(s)
data.log_scan_interval: Scan Interval in Seconds for the log data

data_description.name: Name of the integration entry.
data_description.host: IP address or host name of the BYD Battery Box (BMU), e.g. 192.168.16.254.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port of the BMU (default 8080).
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit/slave ID of the BMU (default 1).
data_description.scan_interval: How often the main BMU values (SOC, power, voltage, …) are read. Minimum 10 seconds.
data_description.bms_scan_interval: How often the detailed tower data (cell voltages and temperatures) is read. Minimum 60 seconds.
data_description.log_scan_interval: How often new log entries are read. Minimum 120 seconds.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BYD Battery Box
reconfigure.description: Change the connection settings. The integration is stopped while the new settings are tested.
